eras.name: Foundations
eras.intro: October 2024 to late 2025. Darkseid remakes the world and takes something from every hero in it — the money, the mentor, the home. Six titles launch in two waves and the shape of a new universe comes into focus.

eras.name: After Absolute Evil
eras.intro: The villains take the stage. Absolute Evil turns the line toward its second year: heroes meet for the first time, a Gotham black site gives up its history, and two of the dead come back wearing someone else’s story.

arcs.name: December 2024
arcs.blurb: The line opens — Darkseid remakes the world, and the founding titles arrive alongside the mandatory prologue. 3 issues: Batman, Wonder Woman, the All-In Special.
